summary.title: Paper in 3 Minutes
keyPoints: The Critical View of the Myopectineal Orifice (CV-MPO) is a standardized safety endpoint
Before mesh placement, all four quadrants of the MPO must be clearly visualized
The CV-MPO is a binary check: it is either achieved or not achieved
This concept parallels the Critical View of Safety in cholecystectomy
Achieving CV-MPO prevents mesh malposition and reduces recurrence
summary.clinicalPearl: The CV-MPO is pass/fail - if you cannot see all four quadrants clearly, you are not ready for mesh placement.

flashcards.front: What are the four quadrants of the myopectineal orifice?
flashcards.back: Superior-medial (direct space), Superior-lateral (indirect space), Inferior-medial (vascular area), Inferior-lateral (femoral space). All must be visualized for CV-MPO.

flashcards.front: What is the CV-MPO concept analogous to?
flashcards.back: The Critical View of Safety (CVS) in laparoscopic cholecystectomy - a standardized endpoint that must be achieved before the critical step.

flashcards.front: When is the CV-MPO considered achieved?
flashcards.back: When all four quadrants are clearly visualized, the cord is parietalized, and key landmarks (IEV, vas, spermatic vessels, Cooper's) are identified.

flashcards.front: What should you do if CV-MPO is not achieved?
flashcards.back: Continue dissection until all quadrants are visualized. Do NOT place mesh until CV-MPO is confirmed.

questions.question: The CV-MPO requires visualization of how many quadrants?
questions.explanation: All four quadrants of the myopectineal orifice must be visualized.

questions.question: The CV-MPO is what type of safety check?
questions.explanation: CV-MPO is binary - it is either achieved or not achieved.

questions.question: What is the CV-MPO analogous to in cholecystectomy?
questions.explanation: CV-MPO parallels the Critical View of Safety concept from cholecystectomy.

questions.question: If only 3 of 4 quadrants are visible, you should:
options: Continue dissection until all 4 are visible
questions.explanation: All four quadrants must be visible. Continue dissection until CV-MPO is achieved.

questions.question: The primary purpose of CV-MPO is to:
options: Standardize the safety endpoint before mesh placement
questions.explanation: CV-MPO standardizes when it is safe to proceed with mesh placement.

takeaways: CV-MPO is a binary safety check: achieved or not achieved
All four quadrants must be visualized before mesh placement
This standardized endpoint reduces mesh malposition and recurrence
pitfalls: Placing mesh before achieving complete CV-MPO
Treating CV-MPO as optional or subjective
Failing to photograph/document the Critical View
